test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II (Statistics) Official Paper-II (Held On: 19 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: The relative frequency of a class is:

options.text: frequency of the class added to total frequency of all classes
frequency of the class multiplied by total frequency of all classes
frequency of the class subtracted from total frequency of all classes
frequency of the class divided by total frequency of all classes

solution:
**Concept:**

Relative frequency is a way to measure how often a particular event occurs compared to the total number of occurrences. It is given by the formula:

**Formula Used:**

Relative frequency = Frequency of the class / Total frequency of all classes
